title: R6R3 Runtime Handoff Operator Semantics R2
description: Authoritative registry for every custom operator referenced by the R2 authentication rules. Operators are total over their declared input shape and fail closed on malformed, duplicate, ambiguous, or unavailable input.

evaluation_procedure: decode UTF-8 without BOM
parse exactly one JSON value with duplicate-key hook
require root type object
reject trailing non-whitespace bytes
reject NaN and Infinity
operators.canonicalization: parser-only; source bytes remain separately hash-bound
operators.success_condition: exactly one finite JSON object parses without duplicate keys
operators.ambiguity_behavior: any duplicate key, multiple value, or non-finite value blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: REJECT
operators.ordering_semantics: object key order is semantically irrelevant; arrays preserve source order

evaluation_procedure: split exact bytes on LF
reject CR bytes and blank records
parse each line with strict_json_object semantics
require every line root type object
retain line order
operators.canonicalization: do not reserialize before exact file hash verification
operators.success_condition: one or more nonblank lines, each exactly one finite JSON object with unique keys
operators.ambiguity_behavior: blank, malformed, duplicate-key, or CRLF line blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: reject duplicate object keys; caller-specific serial/event duplicates are separate operators
operators.ordering_semantics: line order is preserved and is part of source evidence

evaluation_procedure: require manifest_sha256 lowercase 64-hex
copy object
remove exactly package_manifest.manifest_sha256
serialize UTF-8 sorted keys compact separators ensure_ascii=false allow_nan=false
SHA-256 bytes
compare to declared hash
operators.canonicalization: RFC-8785-like stable profile defined by this package; arrays retain order
operators.success_condition: recomputed digest equals declared digest and canonicalization profile equals R2 constants
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing or extra hash-exclusion fields block
operators.duplicate_handling: duplicate keys are rejected before evaluation
operators.ordering_semantics: object keys sorted; arrays unchanged

evaluation_procedure: compare list length to registry length
reject duplicate IDs
compare set equality to the exact 20-ID registry list
require declared order equal registry order where an ordered list is used
operators.canonicalization: IDs compared as exact ASCII strings
operators.success_condition: each required ID appears exactly once and no other ID appears
operators.ambiguity_behavior: duplicate, missing, or unexpected IDs block
operators.duplicate_handling: REJECT
operators.ordering_semantics: set equality plus prescribed order for ordered lists

evaluation_procedure: require absolute path
reject dot segments, glob metacharacters, NUL, relative path, and path aliases
resolve each path component with no-follow semantics
require canonical path beneath exact runtime root
open the object read-only with no-follow
lstat/open/fstat device+inode+regular-file type must match
hash exact opened bytes and compare length/digest
revalidate object identity after read
operators.canonicalization: lexical syntax is checked before filesystem resolution; canonical resolved path is compared component-wise to canonical root
operators.success_condition: one stable regular file object at the declared path is inside the exact root and matches declared hash/length
operators.ambiguity_behavior: any symlink, race, replacement, device/inode mismatch, or canonical containment failure blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: artifact IDs and exact paths must each be unique
operators.ordering_semantics: bindings are evaluated in manifest order, but no selection may depend on order
operators.error_propagation: filesystem errors block; no best effort

evaluation_procedure: canonicalize declared runtime root using same no-follow algorithm
for every required runtime artifact, canonicalize its path
require component-wise root prefix with a separator boundary
require binding.runtime_root equals declared root byte-for-byte after canonical representation
operators.canonicalization: no symlink resolution through any component; canonical root identity is fixed before artifact reads
operators.success_condition: all and only required runtime artifact paths are under one exact root
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing root, multiple roots, lexical escape, or alias blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: a path cannot serve two artifact IDs
operators.ordering_semantics: all bindings checked; one failure blocks the package
operators.error_propagation: propagate first deterministic failure code and retain all diagnostics

evaluation_procedure: read exact opened bytes to EOF
compute SHA-256
count bytes
compare digest and byte_length
perform post-read fstat identity check
operators.canonicalization: none; exact bytes only
operators.success_condition: digest, length, and stable object identity all match
operators.ambiguity_behavior: short read, changed object, or unreadable content blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: not applicable
operators.ordering_semantics: bytes are read in file order

evaluation_procedure: resolve declared committed source state independently
verify commit object exists and is reachable by the stated resolution method
read exact source paths from that state
recompute each source hash
compare source hashes and commit-derived paths with manifest entries
operators.canonicalization: source bytes are exact bytes; commit IDs are lowercase full SHA-1
operators.success_condition: one independently resolvable committed state exists and every declared source hash matches
operators.ambiguity_behavior: empty local .git, conflicting commits, stale pins, or unresolvable state blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: one source path maps to one source identity
operators.ordering_semantics: source file list is compared as an exact declared list
operators.error_propagation: unavailable provenance is a prerequisite failure, never inferred

evaluation_procedure: validate dedicated receipt schema
require invocation_count=1
require exactly one invocation object
require receipt manifest binding artifact ID and manifest digest
require exact runtime root and run ID binding
require producer identity, authorization, uid/euid, command, times, PID identity, exit status, and result fields
operators.canonicalization: receipt_hash is SHA-256 of canonical receipt object with receipt_hash omitted
operators.success_condition: one and only one complete invocation satisfies all const constraints and its hash matches
operators.ambiguity_behavior: multiple invocations, missing authorization, missing binding, or partial identity blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: duplicate invocation IDs or receipt keys block
operators.ordering_semantics: the one invocation is not order-selected; arrays with any other count block

evaluation_procedure: compare run ID, runtime root, command, program path, UID/EUID, exit code, result status, classification, micro-probe verdict, cleanup state, and Mininet fact
require every compared value has exact equality
operators.canonicalization: strings and integers compare without coercion
operators.success_condition: all required receipt and summary fields are equal
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing or duplicate summary fields block
operators.duplicate_handling: duplicate JSON keys rejected at parse
operators.ordering_semantics: field order irrelevant

evaluation_procedure: require one declared run ID
check every runtime JSON object run_id
check every raw, normalized, join, and child evidence row run_id
exclude only separately declared design-source paths
operators.canonicalization: exact string equality
operators.success_condition: all runtime records carry the one declared run ID
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing run ID or mixed run IDs blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: duplicate rows are handled by record-specific operators
operators.ordering_semantics: all records checked
operators.error_propagation: first mismatch blocks and is reported

evaluation_procedure: strict-parse JSONL
require positive integer serial
reject duplicate serial
strict base64 decode raw_bytes_b64
hash decoded bytes
compare raw_sha256
require nonempty record_types and recompute record types from decoded audit bundle
operators.canonicalization: record hash uses decoded bytes; file hash uses exact JSONL bytes
operators.success_condition: every raw row is well-formed, uniquely serialized, and self-hashing
operators.ambiguity_behavior: invalid base64, duplicate serial, or undecodable text blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: REJECT
operators.ordering_semantics: row order preserved; serial is the join key

evaluation_procedure: strict-parse JSONL
require unique event_id and raw_serial
require one of eight event classes
strict base64 decode raw_event_bytes_b64
hash decoded bytes
compare raw_event_sha256
require role and full join identity fields
operators.canonicalization: record hash uses decoded bytes; file hash uses exact JSONL bytes
operators.success_condition: every normalized row is uniquely identified, self-hashing, class-valid, and role-bearing
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing role, duplicate IDs, invalid class, or invalid base64 blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: REJECT
operators.ordering_semantics: row order preserved; raw_serial is the raw join key

evaluation_procedure: index raw rows by serial
for every normalized row require exactly one raw row
compare decoded bytes and SHA-256 values byte-for-byte
recompute link failure count
operators.canonicalization: no text normalization; decoded bytes are authoritative
operators.success_condition: every normalized raw_serial maps to exactly one identical raw bundle
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing or multiple raw candidates blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: duplicates block before join
operators.ordering_semantics: join by integer serial, not row position

evaluation_procedure: require exact watched_path/path equality
require watched path in pre-created permission path set
require file_identity_paths contains watched path
index raw records by exact serial
require same-serial SYSCALL and PATH records
require supported successful syscall, exact audit key, exact PATH name, and serial equality
operators.canonicalization: paths compare as exact canonical path strings
operators.success_condition: the one event is proven by one same-serial successful syscall/path bundle
operators.ambiguity_behavior: cross-serial key/path, inferred syscall, or multiple candidate records blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: multiple same-kind records for the asserted key on one serial block unless schema explicitly declares one deterministic record
operators.ordering_semantics: raw bundle order is retained but matching is by serial and record type
operators.error_propagation: any absent or contradictory assertion blocks

evaluation_procedure: construct key tuple in declared field order
require all six fields on both sides
require exact type/value equality
index join rows by full tuple
require exactly one JOINED row for each process-bearing normalized row
reject duplicate join rows and unmatched rows
operators.canonicalization: tuple order is fixed: run_id, logical_host_id, pid, pid_start_time_ticks, netns_inode, role
operators.success_condition: every process-bearing row has exactly one unique role-bearing JOINED row
operators.ambiguity_behavior: zero or more than one candidate blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: REJECT
operators.ordering_semantics: join is keyed, never positional
operators.error_propagation: type mismatch, missing field, or ambiguity blocks

evaluation_procedure: count normalized rows by exact event_type
compare to declared eight-class map
require all eight classes present and no unexpected class
compare total and FILE_READ_OR_WRITE count
require duplicate and loss counts zero
operators.canonicalization: class order is fixed by the R2 eight-class list
operators.success_condition: declared coverage equals recomputed coverage exactly
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing, unexpected, or non-integer count blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: event and raw serial uniqueness checked before counting
operators.ordering_semantics: required class output order is fixed

evaluation_procedure: hash exact bytes at selected r6_pcap path
compare to pcap_authentication.sha256
compare to coverage pcap_sha256 and post-cleanup pcap_sha256
require artifact ID and exact selected path binding
require provenance_only true and graph-edge-source false
operators.canonicalization: binary bytes are hashed exactly; no packet reserialization
operators.success_condition: all three authenticated sources name the same exact PCAP bytes
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing, multiple, or mismatched hash source blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: hash source artifact ID list must equal the exact three IDs
operators.ordering_semantics: hash source IDs use fixed order r6_pcap, r6_coverage_and_loss, r6_post_cleanup

evaluation_procedure: require pre-state baseline and persistent hashes
derive successful additions from journal entries
derive successful deletions from journal entries
require successful deletions exactly equal successful additions
require all IDs belong to transient contract
require residual transient rules empty
compare after baseline and persistent hashes to pre-state
require post-cleanup revalidation after all reads and zero loss/backlog/residue
operators.canonicalization: rule IDs are exact strings; hashes are lowercase hex
operators.success_condition: all equations and evidence-derived states pass; claimed booleans are ignored unless recomputed
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing evidence, duplicate IDs, global delete, or contradictory claims blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: duplicate journal operation for same rule/result blocks unless distinct operation IDs are supplied
operators.ordering_semantics: journal order retained; set equations use exact ID sets

evaluation_procedure: require template_status not equal NOT_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE for runtime candidate
require runtime_evidence_present true
require package_type authenticated handoff
reject null run identity, null source lineage, and must_not_be_consumed markers
operators.canonicalization: exact field/value comparison
operators.success_condition: candidate explicitly identifies authenticated runtime evidence and is not the minimum/template package
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing or conflicting status blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: duplicate keys rejected at parse
operators.ordering_semantics: not applicable

evaluation_procedure: re-read only exact selected paths
revalidate all object identities and hashes
recompute manifest canonical bytes and digest
require no rule failure remains
require no mutation occurred during reads
operators.canonicalization: same R2 canonical JSON profile and exact binary hashes
operators.success_condition: all previous results remain valid after final read and canonical bytes are unchanged
operators.ambiguity_behavior: any changed object, stale hash, or newly observed error blocks
operators.duplicate_handling: same strict duplicate rules apply on final parse
operators.ordering_semantics: validation order is the declared H001-H017 order

evaluation_procedure: require adapter and encoder changed flags false
require detector, inference, formal experiment, E0-B privileged command, and runtime fabrication flags false
require PCAP graph-edge-source flag false
operators.canonicalization: boolean values compare without coercion
operators.success_condition: all forbidden-operation and mutation flags satisfy their R2 constants
operators.ambiguity_behavior: missing or non-boolean boundary fields block
operators.duplicate_handling: duplicate JSON keys rejected at parse
operators.ordering_semantics: all boundary fields checked
